text:
OPEN QUESTION RESOLVED, AND THE ANSWER IS FAVOURABLE TO THE PACKAGE. I wrote on this bead that because the encoding-retrieval section builds its cross form by hand and never calls the engine, 'a reader cannot tell whether the package supports this path or whether the vignette is illustrating a concept the package does not yet execute'. I tested it. THE ENGINE SUPPORTS IT.

  measurement_form(left, between, by, over, RIGHT, reducer, storage, ...)

measurement_form carries a right argument, and it accepts two relations built over DIFFERENT effect spaces. Verified:

  encoding relation   3 conditions   word, face, place            basis encoding:v1
  retrieval relation  4 conditions   word_old, face_old, place_old, lure   basis retrieval:v1
  match_control operator             3 x 4, as the unequal axes require

  measurement_form(left = rel_e, right = rel_r, between = edge_frame(...), by = q, over = ov)
    -> effect_measurement_form, built, with a populated block index and a readable
       frobenius_strength of 0.006909325

So the capability is real, executes, and produces a well-formed unequal-axis form. The vignette section is not illustrating vapourware; it is UNDERSTATING A WORKING FEATURE by demonstrating it with hand arithmetic.

THAT CHANGES THE SEVERITY OF THIS BEAD IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. Better, because nothing is missing from the engine and the fix is purely a vignette rewrite. Worse, because the package's most distinctive capability - forms whose two axes carry independently named bases, which is the thing no competing tool does - is demonstrated in the documentation by a matrix product the reader could have written themselves. The one section where effectagram has no competitor is the section that shows the least of the package.

SCOPE OF WHAT I VERIFIED, stated precisely because I have been burned on this today. I confirmed the unequal-axis form BUILDS and returns readable components. I did NOT verify its numbers against an independent hand computation - my attempt at that failed on my own non-conformable matrix algebra, not on the package - so unlike the symmetric case, where I checked the diagonal and off-diagonal blocks to 2.22e-16, the unequal-axis numerics remain unverified by me. Someone should check them before this capability is advertised.

REVISED FIX for this bead: route the vignette example through measurement_form with left and right relations, rather than through encoding_profiles %*% t(retrieval_profiles). The call exists, it works, and using it would convert the section from a hand-worked illustration into a demonstration of the only thing this package can do that its competitors cannot.
